result.summary: Several layout and styling problems: truncated restaurant names, clipped category chips, a cut-off promo card, and a bottom nav that highlights Profile instead of Home.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' is clipped at the right edge so the name reads as 'Trattoria Piccol' and the image is cut off.
issues.suggestion: Give the horizontal list enough end padding or allow full-width cards so names and images are fully visible, or add a peek affordance that doesn't truncate content.

issues.description: The last category chip ('Healthy') is cut off at the right edge of the screen, implying more categories exist but they aren't fully shown.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing inset to the chip scroller or scale chips so the last visible chip isn't cropped.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is cropped by the bottom navigation bar, hiding restaurant details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully above the nav.

issues.description: The bottom tab bar highlights Profile (green) while this screen is clearly the Home feed.
issues.suggestion: Set the Home tab as selected on this screen and use the inactive style for Profile.

issues.description: The promo banner's decorative circles and right edge look tightly cropped against the card bounds.
issues.suggestion: Inset the illustration or allow it to bleed with consistent padding so the graphic isn't clipped.
